description: Redemption Girdle Level 60 Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Redemption Girdle if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Girdle, 8 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 3 Nexus Crystals. Requirements: - Desecrated Girdle - Wartorn Plate Scrap x 8 - Arcanite Bar - Nexus Crystal x 3
